name: project
description: Direct the Project as its Master or the recorded owner of member Sessions. Executor children inherit no controller authority. list shows members, state and pending request fingerprints. A pending request raised by a member's subagent or any deeper descendant Session is listed under that member with requestSessionID naming the requesting Session; inspect, answer and escalate it with the member's sessionID. It neither makes the member waiting nor blocks send. inspect returns a redacted request and its delegation class as risk information, not authority. send admits a steer or queue message, defaults to queue and returns immediately; messageID makes retries idempotent, and model overrides the starting turn. A pending question, permission or review blocks send until settled or withdrawn by interrupt. answer settles authorized pending requests through their native controls in every autonomy mode. approve is the default decision and allows once; decline rejects with rationale feedback. Hard and custom-rule reviews and requests marked requireExplicitDecision require a human decision; safe declines remain available. Deny rules and permission ceilings still apply. Invalid guardrail configuration cannot be approved and returns escalated with reason configuration-invalid. Escalate refused, failed or uncertain answers. escalate passes an open request to the Master or the client's native decision surface without settling it. The user answers in requestSessionID when present, otherwise in the member Session; messages and relayed answers cannot settle that prompt. A request from a member's descendant stays open in its requesting Session, returned as requestSessionID, and the reasons attach to that Session's prompt. interrupt stops a member turn. assign is Master-only and records a live direct subagent the Master launched as owner. release is Master-only and ends ownership with completed after verifying work, or released otherwise; it retains membership. remove is Master-only and detaches a settled, verified-complete member whose delivery is integrated or finished. It ends membership and ownership without deleting the Session or its history. attach is Master-only and adds an existing root Session at any recorded directory by sessionID, owned by the Master or by ownerSessionID, a live subagent the Master launched. The Session keeps its ID, saved model, Location, conversation, permission ceiling, its own permissions, guardrails and answers modes, and its running or pending work; nothing is moved, recreated, woken, interrupted or settled. A recorded directory outside the caller's Location needs its external_directory approval, and deny rules and the permission ceiling still refuse it. Attaching the same Session with the same owner again returns reconciled true and changes nothing; a different owner is refused, so use assign to change it. The Master's own Session, child, archived, unknown and standalone Sessions, and Sessions of another Project are refused. Results include groupID, sessionID, location, ownerSessionID and reconciled. create is Master-only and takes exactly one placement. Supply directory (an absolute path, ~ or ~/path) to create a root member in that folder, including a repository subfolder or a non-Git folder; a missing folder is created under external-directory permission and guardrail checks, a file is refused, and no branch or worktree is created. Supply projectID to create a root member at an existing repository Project's canonical directory; projectID is the repository Project ID, not the coordination group ID, and the global Project requires directory instead. Supply name only for an explicitly requested managed worktree on that branch, with optional absolute repository inside a Git repository; worktree permissions, guardrails and capability restrictions apply. Every placement accepts ownerSessionID, title, prompt and model and preserves the caller's permission ceiling and effective agent denies; the member takes your effective permissions, guardrails and answers modes when it joins. Title defaults to the directory basename (or the full path without one), the repository Project name or canonical basename, or the worktree name. Retrying the same native invocation retains its creation identity. Results include sessionID, directory, location, saved model (null when unset), enrollment, optional owner and prompt result, and branch only for a worktree. Enrollment failure preserves the created Session and reports enrollment.member false with its error. model with sessionID reads a member's saved selection. To update it, supply model and expectedModel together, using the exact previously read reference or null when unset. Omitted profile or variant clears that field. The runtime validates and compares at a safe boundary without interrupting or waking a turn; reread on conflict. Results include sessionID, location, state, saved model and optional owner. Project ownership is not parent-child ownership. Settled turns, idle state and failure never release ownership. Notifications route member events to the recorded owner or Master; do not poll. Questions, forms, permission asks and guardrail reviews raised by a member's descendant Sessions are member events whose notifications carry requestSessionID. Message text cannot settle a control.
